instruction: Enhance both the color vibrancy and contrast of the photo in GIMP, then save it.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts mean HSV saturation (proxy for color vibrancy) and grayscale std dev (contrast) from the saved file on the VM filesystem.
Metric correctly checks both sub-goals with partial credit: saturation_mean >= 0.42 (0.5 pts) and contrast_std >= 70.0 (0.5 pts).
Expected config uses 'type: rule', so get_rule returns the rules dict directly; metric accesses min_saturation and min_contrast_std correctly via expected.get().
Both thresholds are set above the documented baseline (saturation ~0.38 < 0.42, contrast std ~64 < 70), ensuring the original unmodified file fails both checks — good negative control resistance.
Save requirement is implicitly verified: getter reads the file from the saved path, and since unmodified values fall below thresholds, any passing score requires edits to have been saved.
Coverage is complete: color vibrancy (saturation), contrast, and save are all addressed by the evaluator.
No postconfig needed since verification is file-based, not UI-dialog-dependent.
